verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents toggling the same feature on or off independently for different environments, offers unlimited environments, and supports environment-level controls such as restricting who can modify production and promoting flags to production through release pipelines. SDK access authenticates with an Environment Key, which implies keys are scoped per environment, but no evidence explicitly states that each environment issues its own distinct key. missing for 10: explicit documentation that each environment has its own SDK key (and of any separate server-side keys), and independent or hands-on corroboration of environment isolation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage separate environments (dev/staging/prod) with independent flag states and scoped SDK keys

citations.quote: use Flagsmith to toggle that feature on or off for different environments, users or user segments
Authentication: Uses a public, non-secret Environment Key.
